llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define and register a Details screen route in the stack navigator.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Details screen is registered in the static stack navigator screens object.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must update header title from `useLayoutEffect` to avoid flicker on initial render.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Header title is set inside useEffect, not useLayoutEffect, which does not prevent the initial render flicker.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createNativeStackNavigator is called with a static config object and the result is passed to createStaticNavigation.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must set the stack header title in screen logic via `setOptions`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: DetailsScreen calls navigation.setOptions({ title: name }) at runtime to update the stack header title.
